text: Google Cloud and Mysten Labs Partner to Build "Verifiable Agent Arbiter" for Verifying AI Agent Actions Onchain Mysten Labs, the developer behind the Sui blockchain, announced a joint development initiative with Google Cloud to build the "Verifiable Agent Arbiter" (VAA), an infrastructure framework designed to cryptographically verify that AI agents act strictly within authorized bounds. VAA decouples private operational logs from cryptographic proofs: detailed execution prompts, outputs, and policy decisions are housed privately within customer-managed Google Cloud storage. While cryptographic integrity proofs are anchored to the Walrus storage protocol and coordinated via the Sui network. Designed to resolve B2B transaction disputes and prevent rogue prompt injections, VAA also integrates with Sui's native "x402" payment standard, enabling autonomous agents to discover services, trigger payments, and verify settlement trails entirely onchain. — link
